criteria.criterion: With `agent.plan = copilot`: `vloop run` prints `  ! agent.plan is copilot: experimental (docs/guide/configuration.md)` and goes ahead; `vloop doctor` prints `! agent.plan is copilot: experimental (docs/guide/configuration.md)` and the copilot and copilot login rows. This holds also on a resume that will not plan (after `vloop run --plan-only`).
criteria.evidence: doctor.go copilotPlan/copilotKeys add agent.plan with no run.* switch; run.go whitelists agent.plan warning; TestDoctorCopilotPlanExperimental covers doctor and preflight with run.verify=false

criteria.criterion: `vloop run` with `agent.plan = copilot` (from the file or `VLOOP_AGENT_PLAN`) and `model.plan` at its default refuses before any session, exit 1: `vloop: agent.plan is copilot but model.plan is the default "opus", a Claude alias: set model.plan to a Copilot model id` — on a resume too.
criteria.evidence: run.go:211-216 loops over copilotKeys, now including agent.plan; TestRunPreflightRefusesDefaultPlanModel asserts the exact message; config.Get honors env

criteria.criterion: With `agent.plan = copilot`, a project skill directory under `.claude/skills/` or `.github/skills/` named like one of vloop's skills stops `vloop run` with K1's message (`vloop: .claude/skills/plan has the name of vloop's plan skill; a copilot session may load it instead — rename it`), exit 1, no session, and is an error row in doctor.
criteria.evidence: run.go:204-206 and doctorCopilot error rows, now reached via the key; TestCopilotPlanSkillWithPluginNameStopsTheRun

criteria.criterion: With `agent.plan = copilot`, no GitHub login reaching the sessions refuses the run naming `agent.plan` (`vloop: agent.plan is copilot but no GitHub login reaches its sessions: …`), exit 1, and is doctor's copilot login error row; copilot missing or `copilot --version` failing is doctor's copilot error row and stops the run.
criteria.evidence: run.go:207-209 uses keys[0]=agent.plan (first in list); TestCopilotPlanLoginRefusal; doctorCopilot copilot row resProblem counts toward bad

criteria.criterion: With `agent.plan = claude` none of this appears, and a project skill named `plan` stops nothing. The checks for agent.work, agent.review, agent.second-review, agent.verify and agent.gate-review keep their words and behaviour.
criteria.evidence: TestPlanOnClaudeSaysNothing; other keys' code untouched and go check log passes existing tests

criteria.criterion: Committed tests cover the warning, the model.plan refusal, K1, the login refusal, the resume and the claude case for agent.plan (extending the existing doctor and run preflight tests); a code comment that lists the Copilot phases or keys (doctor's experimental warning and copilotKeys included) names plan too.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor_copilot_plan_test.go has all five tests, following the sibling per-phase test files; comments updated on copilotExperimental, copilotKeys, doctorCopilot
